005package org.wpilib.networktables;
006
007/** Network table data types. */
008public enum NetworkTableType {
009  /** Unassigned data type. */
010  UNASSIGNED(0, ""),
011  /** Boolean data type. */
012  BOOLEAN(0x01, "boolean"),
013  /** Double precision floating-point data type. */
014  DOUBLE(0x02, "double"),
015  /** String data type. */
016  STRING(0x04, "string"),
017  /** Raw data type. */
018  RAW(0x08, "raw"),
019  /** Boolean array data type. */
020  BOOLEAN_ARRAY(0x10, "boolean[]"),
021  /** Double precision floating-point array data type. */
022  DOUBLE_ARRAY(0x20, "double[]"),
023  /** String array data type. */
024  STRING_ARRAY(0x40, "string[]"),
025  /** Integer data type. */
026  INTEGER(0x100, "int"),
027  /** Single precision floating-point data type. */
028  FLOAT(0x200, "float"),
029  /** Integer array data type. */
030  INTEGER_ARRAY(0x400, "int[]"),
031  /** Single precision floating-point array data type. */
032  FLOAT_ARRAY(0x800, "float[]");
033
034  private final int m_value;
035  private final String m_valueStr;
036
037  NetworkTableType(int value, String valueStr) {
038    m_value = value;
039    m_valueStr = valueStr;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Returns the NetworkTable type value.
044   *
045   * @return The NetworkTable type value.
046   */
047  public int getValue() {
048    return m_value;
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Returns the NetworkTable type value as as string.
053   *
054   * @return The NetworkTable type value as a string.
055   */
056  public String getValueStr() {
057    return m_valueStr;
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Convert from the numerical representation of type to an enum type.
062   *
063   * @param value The numerical representation of kind
064   * @return The kind
065   */
066  public static NetworkTableType getFromInt(int value) {
067    return switch (value) {
068      case 0x01 -> BOOLEAN;
069      case 0x02 -> DOUBLE;
070      case 0x04 -> STRING;
071      case 0x08 -> RAW;
072      case 0x10 -> BOOLEAN_ARRAY;
073      case 0x20 -> DOUBLE_ARRAY;
074      case 0x40 -> STRING_ARRAY;
075      case 0x100 -> INTEGER;
076      case 0x200 -> FLOAT;
077      case 0x400 -> INTEGER_ARRAY;
078      case 0x800 -> FLOAT_ARRAY;
079      default -> UNASSIGNED;
080    };
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Convert from a type string to an enum type.
085   *
086   * @param typeString type string
087   * @return The kind
088   */
089  public static NetworkTableType getFromString(String typeString) {
090    return switch (typeString) {
091      case "boolean" -> BOOLEAN;
092      case "double" -> DOUBLE;
093      case "float" -> FLOAT;
094      case "int" -> INTEGER;
095      case "string", "json" -> STRING;
096      case "boolean[]" -> BOOLEAN_ARRAY;
097      case "double[]" -> DOUBLE_ARRAY;
098      case "float[]" -> FLOAT_ARRAY;
099      case "int[]" -> INTEGER_ARRAY;
100      case "string[]" -> STRING_ARRAY;
101      case "" -> UNASSIGNED;
102      default -> RAW;
103    };
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Gets string from generic data value.
108   *
109   * @param data the data to check
110   * @return type string of the data, or empty string if no match
111   */
112  public static String getStringFromObject(Object data) {
113    return switch (data) {
114      case Boolean _ -> "boolean";
115      case Float _ -> "float";
116      // Checking Long because NT supports 64-bit integers
117      case Long _ -> "int";
118      // If typeof Number class, return "double" as the type. Functions as a "catch-all".
119      case Number _ -> "double";
120      case String _ -> "string";
121      case byte[] _, Byte[] _ -> "raw";
122      case boolean[] _, Boolean[] _ -> "boolean[]";
123      case float[] _, Float[] _ -> "float[]";
124      case long[] _, Long[] _ -> "int[]";
125      // If typeof Number class, return "double[]" as the type. Functions as a "catch-all".
126      case double[] _, Double[] _, Number[] _ -> "double[]";
127      case String[] _ -> "string[]";
128      case null, default -> "";
129    };
130  }
131}
